negative gross margins below $12.10 a megawatt
our_interpretation: This is a model-based estimate, not a reported realized margin for a named operator.
I use September 1–29, 2026 for the current cost and model assertions repeated in the post. This does not supply a missing revenue period.
The surrounding GPU discussion suggests an equipped AI facility; shell-only construction estimates are not directly comparable.
I preserve '$12.10 a megawatt' as written. I do not silently insert million or an annual revenue period.
Continuous customer occupancy and no debt are scenario assumptions, not a conditional forecast requiring a subsequent event.
Estimate denotes the author's model basis, not GAAP or audited company accounts.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Reproducible calculations or sufficiently comparable independent measurements materially conflict with the stated costs or margins under the same units, cost coverage and scenario assumptions.
